name: sj-svalbard-company-beneficial-owners
description: Identify, document and register beneficial owners of an ordinary privately held company operating or registered on Svalbard in 2026. Covers the direct ownership and voting thresholds, board appointment rights, other control, indirect chains and combined rights. Separates the register criteria from anti-money-laundering customer checks and distinguishes no owner from an owner who cannot be identified. Explains RRH-0100 in Altinn, personal and intermediary fields, signing and message access, change deadlines, retention, correction orders and coercive fines. Two cases test the exact direct threshold and the indirect-control rule. Listed companies, foundations, trusts and the special foreign-branch route require their own statutory branches before this ordinary company method is used.
